bayts.text: And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon him who through me glories before the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his mighty standing, my verses the highest of Your good pleasure, O Remover of suppressed grief.
And bless, O Lord of creation, and grant peace upon Your illuminating lamp (Qurʾān 33:46), the ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And choose for me, O Allah, in my creeds, word and deed: You are my leader.
And raise them all without rejection, and efface the turning of what grieves, such as toil.
And make my moving together with my stillness like the worship of those firmly established.
And make Your good pleasure, forever, my breaths, without harm, O Effacer of crushings.
And make my writing like every (message) sent, O You Who have granted me the rewards of the Messengers
in what passed between me and whoever disbelieved, before; and You have been for me with what puts people to shame.
O Allah, bless and grant peace perpetually upon our Intercessor, the Bearer of glad tidings, Aḥmad,
his Family and his Companions; and teach my heart by his standing, and keep all of me safe.
And bear witness for me, forever, that I am a believer, a Muslim and a doer of good, and that I persevere.
And lead through him to my breast and my pen the best sciences, O Remover of pain.
O You Whose reward has made me forget the enemies and their harm, O Bestower of excellence,
bless with a blessing and grant peace upon him who guided with the finest speech,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his standing, my offerings with You perpetually magnified.
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon him through whom You dispelled my darknesses,
just as through him You effaced my wrongdoing and the veil, and through him bestowed on me the finest of answers.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn the hearts of those who hated me toward other than what grieves me, O You Who made them all harmless to me alike.
And make Satan and his host despair of me, and grant me knowledge and acceptance.
And make worship of You, for me, sweeter than any other, O You with Whom is what is sweetest.
And make through him my life a mighty worship for You; grant me to magnify it.
Grant me to honour all the sacred things of Allah (Qurʾān 22:30), and spare me misery and regrets.
And reward all the Prophets and the Messengers, on my behalf, with good, O Granter of honey.
And reward the Companions with good things, on my behalf, together with the angels, by grace,
after blessing, peace and good pleasure upon them and for them; and lead my aim to me.
Lead to me being triumphant, the gladness of them all, and spare them delusion.
And bless, O Most Merciful, with peace, the son of ʿAbd Allāh, possessed of converse (with Allah),
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And turn away, by his standing, toward others than me all that draws misery or darkness upon me.
And bless, O Allah, with a blessing and peace, him to whom belong the comprehensive words,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And bear witness for me, O Allah, in the singular (month) of Rajab, O You Who through him lead to me the loftiest wonder,
that I am greatly well pleased with You and with an Intercessor who has removed toil.
and that I am the servant of my Lord and the servitor of the Chosen, whose lordship endures.
And bless, O All-Merciful, and grant peace upon the Bearer of glad tidings and Warner, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me desire for what pleases You and aversion to all that does not please You.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon him whose precedence is well known,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make, by his standing, the months and years witnesses for me, and tame the arts (of knowledge) for me.
And illumine faith and Islām, with what is completed through me, and the pens.
And illumine the heart, make the tongue upright, O You to Whom (go) my remembrance and my gratitude with fair things.
And accept the repentance of all my being and purify it wholly, and make my heart skilled.
And make my pens and my ink guides of a manifest guidance for the wise.
And make, by the standing of the Chosen, my customs above the good pleasure of Your servants, the masters.
Āmīn, O Lord of creation, without turbidity or calamity, O You Who through him make the Decree run.
And bless, O One, perpetually, our master, whom You raised and he rose high,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me (the affirmation of) the Oneness of every Messenger and every Companion, and make my writing honey-sweet.
And make my writing dearer to Allah than every writing, and to al-Māḥī, the most Beloved.
And make my speech rightly guided and guiding, and illumine my thought and guide my heart.
And bless, O Subtle, and grant peace upon the Prophet and Messenger, the ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
